question: ¿Cuántos sponsors de la industria distintos, contando solo al sponsor principal de cada ensayo, tienen ensayos que prueban algún fármaco que actúa sobre BRAF?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.name)
FROM aact.sponsors s
JOIN linking.sponsor ls ON ls.name = s.name AND ls.industry
JOIN linking.trial_drug td ON td.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN linking.drug_target dt ON dt.parent_chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
JOIN linking.target_gene tg ON tg.target_chembl_id = dt.target_chembl_id
WHERE s.lead_or_collaborator = 'lead' AND tg.gene_symbol = 'BRAF'
